# `/role-insights` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /role-insights/v1/requests

`createRoleInsightRequestsV1` — Generate insights for roles — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`), DEPRECATED**

Submits a create role insights request to the role insights application. At this time there are no parameters. All business roles will be processed for the customer.

- Scopes: iai:role-insights
- Returns 201: roleinsightsresponse

### GET /role-insights/v1/requests/{id}

`getRoleInsightsRequestsV1` — Returns metadata from prior request. — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`), DEPRECATED**

This endpoint returns details of a prior role insights request.

- Scopes: iai:role-insights
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The role insights request id
- Returns 200: roleinsightsresponse

### GET /role-insights/v1/summary

`getRoleInsightsSummaryV1` — Get role insights summary information — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This method returns high level summary information for role insights for a customer.

- Scopes: iai:role-insights
- Returns 200: roleinsightssummary

### GET /role-insights/v1

`getRoleInsightsV1` — Get role insights — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This method returns detailed role insights for each role.

- Scopes: iai:role-insights
- Parameters:
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: numberOfUpdates, identitiesWithAccess, totalNumberOfIdentities — e.g. `numberOfUpdates`
  - `filters` (query) — fields: name: sw; ownerName: sw; description: sw — e.g. `name sw "John"`
- Returns 200: array of roleinsight

### GET /role-insights/v1/{insightId}

`getRoleInsightV1` — Get a single role insight — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This endpoint gets role insights information for a role.

- Scopes: iai:role-insights
- Parameters:
  - `insightId` (path, required) — The role insight id
- Returns 200: roleinsight

### GET /role-insights/v1/{insightId}/entitlement-changes

`getRoleInsightsEntitlementsChangesV1` — Get entitlement insights for a role — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This endpoint returns entitlement insights for a role.

- Scopes: iai:role-insights
- Parameters:
  - `insightId` (path, required) — The role insight id
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: identitiesWithAccess, name
  - `filters` (query) — fields: name: sw; description: sw — e.g. `name sw "Admin"`
- Returns 200: array of roleinsightsentitlementchanges

### GET /role-insights/v1/{insightId}/entitlement-changes/download

`downloadRoleInsightsEntitlementsChangesV1` — Download entitlement insights for a role — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This endpoint returns the entitlement insights for a role.

- Scopes: iai:role-insights
- Parameters:
  - `insightId` (path, required) — The role insight id
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: identitiesWithAccess The default sort is identitiesWithAccess in descending order. — e.g. `identitiesWithAccess`
  - `filters` (query) — fields: name: sw; description: sw — e.g. `name sw "r"`
- Returns 200: no body

### GET /role-insights/v1/{insightId}/current-entitlements

`getRoleInsightsCurrentEntitlementsV1` — Get current entitlement for a role — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This endpoint gets the entitlements for a role. The term "current" is to distinguish from the entitlement(s) an insight might recommend adding.

- Scopes: iai:role-insights
- Parameters:
  - `insightId` (path, required) — The role insight id
  - `filters` (query) — fields: name: sw; description: sw — e.g. `name sw "r"`
- Returns 200: array of roleinsightsentitlement

### GET /role-insights/v1/{insightId}/entitlement-changes/{entitlementId}/identities

`getEntitlementChangesIdentitiesV1` — Get identities for a suggested entitlement (for a role) — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Role insights suggests entitlements to be added for a role. This endpoint returns a list of identities in the role, with or without the entitlements, for a suggested entitlement so that the user can see which identities would be affected if the suggested entitlement were to be added to the role.

- Scopes: iai:role-insights
- Parameters:
  - `insightId` (path, required) — The role insight id
  - `entitlementId` (path, required) — The entitlement id
  - `hasEntitlement` (query) — default False — Identity has this entitlement or not
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: name — e.g. `name`
  - `filters` (query) — fields: name: sw — e.g. `name sw "Jan"`
- Returns 200: array of roleinsightsidentities
